infoHub.quote: I can find the most important OGS information in one place and no longer have to search through emails or paper notes.
infoHub.author: Parent

easyReplies.quote: Getting back to the care team is much easier because not every topic has to go through phone calls or separate emails.
easyReplies.author: Parent

lookUpLater.quote: When everyday life gets busy, it really helps that I can look up later what the OGS shared.
lookUpLater.author: Parent

organized.quote: Communication feels much more organized. We know faster what matters and where to find it again.
organized.author: Parent
